reports.quote: Patient P1, who was diagnosed with TNBC, carries an L1 element insertion in intron 8 of the SPIDR gene, seq[GRCh38] der(8)ins(8;?)(q11.21;?) NC_000008.11:g.47,564,681_47,564,682insL1[1,293].

reports.quote: an insertion of a full-length inverted Alu element into the 3'-untranslated region of the SPINK1 gene

events.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (N-TAF1 reduction in iPSC-NSCs)

reports.quote: Compared with control cells, XDP fibroblasts exhibited decreased expression of TAF1 transcript fragments derived from exons 32-36, a region spanning the SVA insertion site.
reports.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (N-TAF1 reduction in iPSC-NSCs)

reports.mechanism_detail: The XDP-specific SVA inserted antisense in TAF1 intron 32 has a polymorphic CCCTCT hexamer (35-52 repeats) whose length inversely correlates with age at onset; reporter assays show the SVA modulates transcription and the authors propose transcriptional interference (RNAP II barriers, G-quadruplexes) reducing TAF1 transcription/altering splicing.
reports.quote: Within this cohort, the length of the SVA hexamer ranged from 35 to 52 repeats.
reports.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (antisense) with variable hexamer

reports.mechanism_detail: The founder SVA in TAF1 intron 32 is associated with aberrant splicing and partial retention of intron 32 proximal to the SVA (including a cryptic-exon transcript TAF1-32i ending 716 bp 5' of the SVA), decreased exon usage distal to it and reduced canonical TAF1 mRNA and protein in patient-derived neural cells; CRISPR excision of the SVA rescued these changes.
reports.quote: This intron retention (IR) coincided with decreased exon usage in proximity to the SVA and an overall reduction in TAF1 expression, both of which were rescued by CRISPR/Cas9-based excision of the SVA.
reports.case_label: SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (XDP founder)

reports.mechanism_detail: The intron 32 SVA causes alternative splicing (disease-specific TAF1-32i variant) and reduced TAF1 expression 3' to the insertion; patient NPCs, their extracellular vesicles and whole blood show a lower TAF1-3'/5' ratio and higher TAF1-32i.

reports.case_label: SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (XDP): blood TAF1 splicing biomarkers

reports.mechanism_detail: The intronic SVA (known to cause aberrant splicing/partial intron 32 retention and lower full-length TAF1) is associated with decreased acetylated H3 at the exon immediately proximal to the SVA; CRISPR excision of the SVA normalized AcH3, suggesting a local chromatin effect on TAF1 expression.
reports.quote: There was, however, a decrease in AcH3 association with the exon immediately proximal to the intronic SVA, and this decrease was normalized by CRISPR/Cas-excision of the SVA.
reports.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (histone H3 acetylation)

reports.mechanism_detail: Cell-based splicing assays, RT-PCR and Nanopore long-read sequencing of XDP vs control brain TAF1 mRNA showed the SVA does not reduce inclusion of neuron-specific microexon 34' and transcript architecture is similar; the authors discount 34' mis-splicing as the disease mechanism.
reports.quote: Using cell-based splicing assays, we demonstrate that presence of the disease-associated SINE-VNTR-Alu does not affect the inclusion of microexon 34′.
reports.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (microexon 34' splicing not affected)

reports.mechanism_detail: The SVA reduces TAF1 expression and increases the NMD-sensitive intron-retention transcript TAF1-32i in patient cells and blood (normalised by SVA excision); the region carries epigenetic marks and the SVA represses the TAF1 promoter in reporter assays.
reports.quote: A SINE-VNTR-Alu (SVA) retrotransposon inserted in an intron of the TAF1 gene reduces its expression and alters splicing in XDP patient-derived cells.
reports.case_label: SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (XDP): TAF1-32i intron retention and promoter repression

reports.mechanism_detail: Study of the polymorphic (AGAGGG)n hexamer repeat within the founder intron 32 SVA in 202 patients; mosaic divergent repeat interruptions are described as possible modifiers of repeat length and age at onset. Mechanism of TAF1 disruption not investigated.
reports.quote: X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism (XDP) is a neurodegenerative disease caused by a SINE-VNTR-Alu(AGAGGG)n retrotransposon insertion in TAF1, with a polymorphic (AGAGGG)n repeat.
reports.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (hexamer repeat interruptions)

reports.mechanism_detail: The XDP-SVA in a TAF1 intron alters TAF1 transcription and splicing, reducing canonical TAF1 and producing the XDP-specific aberrant TAF1-32i transcript that incorporates intron 32 sequence; this study shows the SVA carries glucocorticoid receptor sites and has CORT-inducible promoter activity in reporter assays, studied in one patient fibroblast line.
reports.quote: X-linked Dystonia Parkinsonism (XDP) is associated with a SINE-VNTR- Alu (SVA) retrotransposon insertion in an intron of the TAF1 gene that alters gene transcription and splicing.
reports.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron (glucocorticoid-responsive elements)

reports.mechanism_detail: In XDP patient-derived neural progenitor cells, ZNF91 deposits H3K9me3/DNA methylation over the intronic SVA, forming a mini-heterochromatin domain; removing it aggravates the XDP phenotype with increased TAF1 intron retention and reduced TAF1 expression, i.e. the SVA causes intron retention/reduced expression that heterochromatin partly constrains.
reports.quote: This is critical for XDP pathology; removal of local heterochromatin severely aggravates the XDP molecular phenotype, resulting in increased TAF1 intron retention and reduced expression.
reports.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (ZNF91 heterochromatin)

reports.mechanism_detail: The XDP-SVA in TAF1 intron 32 forms G-quadruplex structures that impede RNA Pol II, producing truncated transcripts containing intron 32 (i32) and less full-length TAF1; the KRAB-ZNF ZNF91 binds and represses the SVA, and ZNF91 knockout in patient iPSC-derived cells worsens i32 retention/failed splicing, while SVA excision rescues it.
reports.quote: In XDP, the pathogenic XDP-SVA insertion forms G4 structures that obstruct RNA Pol progression, resulting in the production of truncated transcripts containing intron 32 (i32).
reports.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (ZNF91-repressed)

reports.mechanism_detail: G-quadruplexes form in the hexamer and VNTR of the XDP SVA in patient fibroblasts and NPCs; stabilising them with ligands reduced TAF1 transcripts around/downstream of the SVA and increased upstream ones, while unfolding G4s increased TAF1 transcripts, implicating G4s as a cause of aberrant TAF1 expression.
reports.quote: Our data indicate that G4 formation in the XDP SVA is a major cause of aberrant TAF1 expression, opening the way for the development of strategies to unfold G4s and potentially target the disease.
reports.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (G-quadruplexes)

reports.mechanism_detail: A 78-kb XDP patient-derived TAF1 segment carrying the intron 32 SVA_F was written into mouse Taf1; the SVA is actively transcribed and acts as an elongation barrier, causing premature termination of TAF1 transcription at intron 32 (cryptic splice acceptor/polyA), reduced TAF1, TATA-gene downregulation, apoptosis, and striatal atrophy in male mice.
reports.quote: Proposed model: transcription of SVA_F, and to a lesser extent, SVA_D, causes premature termination of TAF1 transcription at intron 32.
reports.case_label: XDP SVA_F in TAF1 intron 32 (reverse orientation; humanized mouse model)

reports.mechanism_detail: The intron 32 SVA causes cryptic alternative splicing (AS-i32), partial intron 32 retention and TAF1 dysregulation in patient NSCs and postmortem XDP brain; CRISPR excision of the SVA abolished aberrant splicing and splice-modulating ASOs attenuated it.
reports.quote: We first used CRISPR-based excision of the SVA and demonstrated ablation of all aberrant splicing and dysregulation of TAF1 expression in NSCs across 30 independent clones.
reports.case_label: 2.6-kb SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (XDP): cryptic splicing targeted by ASOs

reports.mechanism_detail: The XDP-causing SVA retrotransposon insertion in TAF1 is taken as the disease variant; this study profiles transcriptomes of XDP patient-derived cortical neurons, showing broad pathway downregulation and increased DNA damage after mitochondrial toxin exposure, without directly testing how the SVA alters TAF1.
reports.quote: The underlying genetic mechanism involves a shared common haplotype identified in all patients, including the disease-causing variant, the SINE-VNTR-Alu (SVA) retrotransposon, within the TAF1 gene.
reports.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 (patient iPSC-derived neurons under mitochondrial stress)

reports.mechanism_detail: A disease-specific SVA in a TAF1 intron is associated with decreased TAF1 (and DRD2) expression in caudate nucleus; abnormal methylation of the SVA in patient caudate is proposed to account for reduced TAF1 expression.

reports.case_label: SVA in TAF1 intron (XDP)

reports.quote: TAF1 reduction in X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism is likely due to the retrotransposon insertion and is recapitulated in induced pluripotent stem cells and differentiated spiny projection neurons.
reports.case_label: 2.6-kb retrotransposon in TAF1 intron 32 (XDP)

reports.quote: RN-dependent TAF1 repression and subsequent differences in TAF1 mRNA levels in patients may be potentiated in the brain through somatic variability leading to the neurological phenotype.

reports.quote: All patients carry the same disease-causing mutation, a ~2.6-kb SINE-VNTR-Alu (SVA)-type retrotransposon insertion in intron 32 of the TAF1 gene2,3.
reports.case_label: Founder SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (XDP) - age-at-onset modifier GWAS
